description: Notification sent to a student after their module enrolment has changed, listing the chat rooms they have been added to and removed from.
subject: Your module chat rooms have been updated
body:
Hello $first_name $last_name,

Your module enrolment has been updated, and your chat-room memberships have been adjusted to match.

Added ($added_count):
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
$added_list
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Removed ($removed_count):
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
$removed_list
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

What to do next:
• Open the Communications dashboard and choose "My Chat Rooms" — the new rooms above will already be listed.
• Any messages you posted in the removed rooms remain there for the rest of the class to read; you simply no longer see new posts.
• If you think a change is incorrect, please contact your module leader or the IT helpdesk.

Kind regards,
University Communications

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
This is an automated notification. Please do not reply to this email.
